newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Court rules against Australis, Optus deal.
newsitem.headline: Court rules against Australis, Optus deal.

text.p: The Supreme Court of New South Wales on Friday ruled against the proposed joint infrastructure venture between Australis Media Ltd and Optus Vision, the pay TV arm of Optus Communications Pty Ltd.

The court ordered Australis to be restrained from transferring its satellite infrastructure to a joint venture with Optus Vision. A spokesman for Optus Vision said: "We are still considering our position in light of the decision."
The action was started by Optus pay TV rival, Foxtel, which is jointly owned by News Corp Ltd and government-owned telecommunications carrier Telstra Corp Ltd.
Foxtel has a 25-year programming deal with Australis.
The Optus-Australis venture was agreed upon last year and was approved by anti-monopolies body, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC).
The satellite deal was seen as an important part of the recapitalisation of Australis last year.
